Someone who is psychologically one particular gender, sees all the things that social custom has codified as belonging to that gender, and automatically (without--or even against!--the will of a given individual) imprints them on wanting to do those things, participate in those activities, and fulfill those roles. However, if someone who is psychologically female but sexually male wants to take on a cooperative, noncompetitive, nurturing social role, look pretty, wear a dress, do gardening, talk with (not to) people who appear to be female, appreciate fashion, (insert a few more insulting female stereotypes here), more often than not they get ridiculed.
